hypothesis: A real local fake executable exit 23 is reported by the unchanged current-main host broker as returncode 23, propagated by broker process exit 23, while exact child stdout and a typed non-authoritative receipt are retained.
case: one actual fake executable process; exit 23; one IPC request; one response and one broker receipt

decision.pass: PASS_REAL_FAKE_CHILD_NONZERO_CONSTRUCTION_SCOPED only when real fake child runs once, broker and receipt returncodes equal 23, stdout/stderr and request identity match, source unchanged, authority false, and independent audit rejects 8/8 corruptions
decision.fail: FAIL if complete child/broker/receipt behavior contradicts a frozen condition
decision.stop: STOP if source/image/output/process or independent-audit provenance is incomplete
